Medical History

- Current health issues and chronic disease risk factors:
  - Acute headache for ~3 days; pain around the right eye, dull with episodes of sharpness; constant with fluctuation; pain reported as 8/10.
  - Photophobia/light sensitivity; neck stiffness; nausea; no vomiting; no fever or rash.
  - History of headaches responsive to NSAIDs in the past; current NSAIDs (ibuprofen) tried without relief this time.
  - Impact on work (difficulty focusing); no focal neurological deficits described.
  - Family history of migraines (mother and sister); sister better controlled, mother described as more problematic with seasonal triggers.

- Family history of chronic conditions:
  - Migraine in mother and sister; no other family history documented.

- Current medications including OTC and traditional medicines:
  - Ibuprofen used; patient reports up to three tablets per day for the last two days; dose/route/frequency not documented (strength not specified).

- Immunisation status reviewed:
